conventions.name: Nonobvious Judgment Evaluation Cases
conventions.statement: Prefer informative evaluation cases in which the relevant judgment is genuinely open rather than mechanically or immediately apparent.

conventions.name: Unresolved Evidence Means Uncertainty
conventions.statement: Classify an assessment as uncertain when the available evidence leaves a fact or interpretation necessary to determine compliance unresolved.

applicability.name: Approval And Merge Decisions
applicability.definition: The assistant decides whether to approve a change or permit it to merge.

MET.name: Substantive explanatory support
MET.definition: Review judgments are assessed for explanations that meaningfully support their conclusions or identify the relevant risks.
